summary_md:
# Meta eksploderer - mens AI-agenter går rogue

**Feed**: store-penge  
**Published**: 2026-09-29  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish podcast (Stor Penge) covering markets despite high US yields and Iran/oil geopolitics. Hosts think sitting on the sidelines doesn't pay. Main topics: AI agents behaving unpredictably (OpenAI pausing training, Anthropic's misuse report, regulation seen as partly self-serving), Meta's new AI assistant Muse, which has lifted the stock 20%+, and Apple's late foldable iPhone. It closes with a quick bullish/bearish round on the Magnificent Seven: everyone is bullish on Alphabet and most bearish on Apple.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 GOOGL — Alphabet | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

All three panelists bullish in the Mag7 round.

#### Reasoning

Alphabet was the only Magnificent Seven name that got unanimous bullish votes from the host and guests. Specific reasons were not given, but the agreement stands out against split views on the others.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI competition erodes search economics
- if hyperscaler capex fails to show returns

> *"Så tror jeg det er den eneste Hvor I faktisk alle tre var bullies Det var Alphabet"*

---

### ⛔ AAPL — Apple | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Panel most bearish on Apple; foldable late, no AI strategy.

#### Reasoning

All panelists voted bearish or slightly bearish. Their view: Apple missed the AI assistant/context opportunity that Meta is capturing with Muse, the foldable iPhone is late and copies Samsung Galaxy, and pricing (from 18,000 DKK) limits its appeal.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Apple launches a credible AI agent strategy
- if foldable iPhone sees strong adoption

> *"for mig er Apple's nye foldbart smartphone for sent på markedet"*

---

### 🟢 TSLA — Tesla | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Two bullish on self-driving and robot optionality; one marginal bearish.

#### Reasoning

One panelist was impressed after a hands-free drive in a self-driving Tesla. Another agreed, citing Tesla's first-mover position in autonomy and a home robot as upside optionality, but worries about Chinese competition. The third was marginally bearish.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Chinese EV/autonomy competition overtakes Tesla
- if self-driving incidents set back adoption

> *"de har bare bevaret den der first mover-position på selvkørende teknologi"*

---

### 🟡 NVDA — Nvidia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Bullish, but seen as not the biggest winner; memory stocks preferred.

#### Reasoning

Two panelists said bullish. A third expects the stock to rise but thinks demand for frontier GPUs may soften as compute shifts from training to inference, so memory-chip stocks could outperform.

#### Sell Triggers

- if frontier GPU demand drops as compute shifts to inference

> *"Den skal nok stige Så helt bearish er det jo ikke"*

---

### 🟠 META — Meta | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Up 20%+ on Muse; panel split, leaning bearish on valuation after the run.

#### Reasoning

Two panelists were bearish: the Muse hype is fading and the stock has risen enough. One was bullish 'for fun' and calls Muse undervalued because of Meta's context/data advantage from WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook. Hyperscalers need to show capex returns, likely into 2027.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Muse adoption stalls
- if capex returns do not materialise into 2027

> *"Jeg synes den er steget rigeligt igen"*

---

### 🟢 MSFT — Microsoft | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Two bullish (one strongly), one slightly bearish.

#### Reasoning

In the quick Mag7 round, one panelist said bullish and another said 'hugely bullish'. The third was slightly bearish and felt the stock had risen enough. No detailed reasons were given.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI monetisation disappoints

> *"Jeg er også kæmpe meget bullish på den, faktisk."*

---
